text: Two humble parts turn up in almost every Tribal Power recipe: the **Spirit Shard** and the **Copper Resonator**. Make a stack of each early and you will rarely be held up.
Both start from a **Bone Chime**: a bone, a string and an amethyst shard make two.

pages.title: Where they come from
text: A Spirit Shard is an amethyst shard, a redstone dust and a Bone Chime, crafted together. Each craft gives **two**.
A Copper Resonator is four copper ingots around a Bone Chime. Each craft also gives **two**.

Once you reach the March, **March Ore** is the cheaper source of shards: put it through [Echo Shatter](echo_shatter) with an Earth totem and it breaks into **two Spirit Shards** in 4 seconds, at 20 Pulse a second before pack settings.

pages.text: The Bone Chime also wakes quiet totems when you ring it nearby.
